title: Notice acknowledgement (notice-ack/v1)
description: One runtime's receipt of one standing notice. The machine that decides whether a record holds is governance/notices/notice_records.py (validate_ack); this schema documents the same rules. An ack is a RECORD, not a counter: a second ack from the same runtime is refused, a re-acknowledgement is a new notice id. An ack whose `runtime` is not a registered runtime is refused by name (ack-from-unregistered-runtime) because it proves nothing, and an ack with no evidence is refused by name (ack-without-evidence) because it says only that something wrote a file.

schema.description: The record version. A record carrying any other value is refused by name.

notice.description: The id of the notice being acknowledged. It must match the directory the record sits in.

runtime.description: The registered runtime that acked. It must match the filename (ack-<runtime>.json) and be in the derived registry.

acked_at.description: When the runtime acknowledged, in UTC.

transport.description: The transport that carried it (mailbox:<path> or adapter:<path>), derived by governance/notices/runtime_registry.py unless the caller names it.

evidence.description: What the runtime read, in its own words: the ack is evidence of receipt, so an empty one is refused by name.
